ladder.label: COUNTER-TREND BOUNCE
ladder.why: Short-term, a daily bottoming setup is forming — but the bigger picture is bearish (weekly momentum curling up; 3-day crossed up; investor cycle failed (broke its start low)). A bounce here is COUNTER-TREND: daily-cycle lows that don't line up with a weekly-cycle low tend to be left-translated and fail, then cascade toward the larger cycle low — exactly the trap of buying a daily low in a falling investor cycle. The daily cycle has already failed (broke its own start low).
ladder.next: Nimble traders only — small size, tight stop below 11.48. Not an investment buy; wait for the weekly timeframe to actually turn up (or a fresh investor-cycle low to confirm) before trusting it.

ladder.regime_line: Bigger picture: MIXED — weekly momentum curling up; 3-day crossed up; investor cycle failed (broke its start low) (investor cycle week 11 · failed · daily cycle broke its start low 19d ago).

ladder.why_zh: 短期来看，正在形成日线筑底形态——但大局看空（weekly momentum curling up; 3-day crossed up; investor cycle failed (broke its start low)）。此处的反弹属于逆势：与周线周期低点不对齐的日线周期低点往往呈左移结构并最终失败，随后向更大周期低点蔓延——这正是在下行的投资者周期中买入日线低点的陷阱。日线周期已经失败（跌破其自身的起始低点）。

Measured: weekly confirmation lifted the 'cycle-low held' rate ~19pp — a higher score held far more often. Risk/durability, NOT a return forecast.
